title: Session 5 · Focus on the whole instruction
description: Twenty inspection and instruction-following tasks, with calculations and rules supplied. Compare an own-approach round with checking-routine practice.
instructions: 25 min maximum. Objective 2 min: preserve source details and complete every requested part. Controls 1 min. Own-approach round up to 7 min with no hints. Then teach READ → KEEP → CHECK for 2 min. Demonstrate on this separate example: source says Shelf 24, blue folder; copy says Shelf 42, blue folder. Read the request, keep every source detail, then correct the shelf number to 24. Checklist round up to 8 min with the routine visible and no answer-specific hints. Debrief 5 min. Stop at 25 min and record unfinished work. Ask for one concrete choice the learner checked or changed. All calculations, values and rule definitions are supplied; the task practices inspecting, copying, selecting relevant information and completing instructions. Record help, interruptions and unclear notation. Compare matched error categories and review uncertain responses using the supplied source. Two different sets in a fixed order cannot isolate checklist effects from practice. Scores describe performance on these tasks. The session uses the general runner under attention_practice and is excluded from focus-only monthly summaries. Existing assignments keep their original content; assign this revision for the updated tasks.
